title: A blocked uv sync names chantier's holders, waits, never kills
summary: A sync of chantier's checkout never stops what holds its .venv: check, list holders, sync only when none, else go on with 'sync pending' and retry each turn. After 3 min, tell the user once; when only its own board and watcher hold it, offer once to stop, sync and restart them on the user's yes.
